provenance.what: counts of finished items from the Craft of Exile emulator (Wraecrafter Ultra), our measurement; no Craft of Exile code
provenance.emulator: https://www.craftofexile.com/?game=poe1 , run headless from a local copy by tools/coe_emulator/record.py
provenance.seeded: driver.js seeds the page's Math.random (mulberry32); the same seed on the same copy repeats the counts

alteration-r13-belt.note: Orb of Alteration on a magic Leather Belt of item level 86 (R13's base)

augmentation-r13-belt.note: Orb of Augmentation on a magic Leather Belt of item level 86 that holds one suffix: it adds a prefix

chaos-r12-amulet.note: Chaos Orb on R12's start amulet: a rare Paua Amulet of item level 84 whose fractured Lightning Resistance stays

chaos-r13-belt.note: Chaos Orb on a rare Leather Belt of item level 86 (R13's base) with four ordinary mods, none fractured: all four are removed

essence-c02-helmet.note: The prototype's case C02 (tests/test_proto_coe_comparison.py): Deafening Essence of Envy on a rare Royal Burgonet of item level 86 with no mod. The Craft of Exile calculator gives our exact chance of Life tier 1 and Fire Resistance tier 1 together 2.09% above its own number; the emulator is the draw itself
